description: Run a shell command on the device (settings, pm, am, dumpsys, getprop, wm, cmd, svc...) and return stdout. It bypasses every guard rail, so it works only while the server option allow_shell is on. For package changes use adb_app instead: dry runs, a protected set, a network guard and a rollback snapshot.

command.description: Command line for the device shell, e.g. "getprop ro.build.version.release". Logged verbatim with log_requests: type secrets with adb_text instead.

serial.description: Device serial from adb_devices. Optional when exactly one device is connected.

timeout_sec.description: Time limit in seconds, default 30, at most 120. Past it the call fails with "timed out".

name: adb_shell
title: Run shell command
